notes: Web model card (ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/paligemma/model-card), not a PDF; no pageCount. Only one seed model (google/paligemma-3b-mix-224) covers the family via checkpoints; single-task columns use rawModelName pt-224/pt-448/pt-896; mix-224 uses the seed id and mix-448 uses rawModelName. Multi-valued cells (COCO-35L/XM3600, SciCap CIDEr/BLEU-4, POPE, RSVQA-HR, TallyQA, RefCOCO) split into one result per number. ChartQA keeps a single Mean Relaxed Accuracy per resolution. FairFace table header rows are malformed in the page markdown; mapped six numeric columns as gender/ethnicity/age × max/median. Infographic VQA row quote shortened to 300 chars (contiguous substring including the numbers). Human safety evals are qualitative only. No formal risk framework levels. No external testers named.
